title: Record V4 Guards 1.2.1 publication and verification
goal: Capture the exact 1.2.1 release commit, certification, immutable asset identities and fresh-download Windows/Linux verification without changing package authority.
acceptanceCriteria: The report records the release-prep PR, exact main merge commit, annotated tag and non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release with exactly four assets.
The report records passing full Guardrails and dual-platform Certification, matching source packageHash, both RID package identities, archive SHA-256 values and recovery source.
The report records fresh-download hash, install, public launcher, four Stage, Companion and verified-uninstall results on Windows and isolated Linux.
Only docs/plans paths change; base-owned Contract, Linux, package and required checks pass, and Windows selection follows the trusted-base Contract.
risks: Confusing source packageHash with RID package identity or ZIP hash would misstate asset provenance.
decisions: Record only completed publication evidence under docs/plans, outside package authority.
Preserve the published tag, Release and four assets without replacement or deletion.
Consumer adoption and activation remain separately governed.
validationCommands: v4-windows when selected by the trusted-base Contract
